messages.content: Classify this warehouse image into one category: spill, forklift_violation, improper_stacking, obstacle, or safe.

category: forklift_violation
description: A yellow forklift is carrying an oversized wrapped load through a narrow aisle between pallet racks. The front two wheels are lifted off the ground, indicating the forklift is tipping forward from the excessive load weight. The operator is still seated but the vehicle is in a dangerous tipping position close to the shelving.
Classify this warehouse image into one category: spill, forklift_violation, improper_stacking, obstacle, or safe.

category: spill
description: A dark fluid puddle is visible on the aisle floor at the bottom foreground of the image. The spill pools near the base of the right-side shelving at the near end of the aisle. A worker in a hi-vis vest is walking in the background, unaware of the spill.
Classify this warehouse image into one category: spill, forklift_violation, improper_stacking, obstacle, or safe.

category: obstacle
description: A large open crate with scattered mechanical parts, industrial components, metal rings, hoses, and fallen cardboard boxes covers the center of the warehouse aisle. The debris field spans most of the aisle width, completely blocking passage between the shelving rows.
Classify this warehouse image into one category: spill, forklift_violation, improper_stacking, obstacle, or safe.

category: spill

category: obstacle

Classify this warehouse image into one category: spill, forklift_violation, improper_stacking, obstacle, or safe.

category: forklift_violation
description: An orange forklift is operating in a narrow aisle between pallet racks with two pedestrian workers standing in dangerously close proximity. One worker in a yellow hi-vis vest is immediately to the left of the forklift, and another worker is visible behind it near the right-side shelving. The confined space provides no safe buffer between the vehicle and the workers.
Classify this warehouse image into one category: spill, forklift_violation, improper_stacking, obstacle, or safe.

category: improper_stacking
description: A forklift is carrying a pallet with an improperly stacked load of cardboard boxes through a narrow aisle. The upper boxes are piled haphazardly and at angles on top of a partially wrapped lower section, creating an unstable load that risks falling during transport. A second worker is visible on the far left of the image.
Classify this warehouse image into one category: spill, forklift_violation, improper_stacking, obstacle, or safe.

category: safe
description: An elevated drone view of a warehouse aisle with white and silver metal shelving on both sides stocked with cardboard boxes. The wide concrete aisle is clear of obstacles, the floor is dry with only normal tire marks, and all boxes are properly stacked. Blue structural columns support the shelving. No personnel or equipment hazards are visible.

category: safe
